propositions: FAIL remediation guidance omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence, directing callers to incomplete retry paths.
ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md intentionally classify untagged criteria as codebase-verifiable and require the exact tag for external evidence admission.
An operator followed generic remediation guidance, added concrete ticket-comment evidence without the [operator-attested] tag, and received a second contractually correct FAIL.
Remediation guidance must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and name the exact tag prerequisite.
The interface test for FAIL remediation guidance must require the canonical tag and affirm that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone.
